style: Use case: illustration-story. A NEW original 16:9 hand-painted game environment for Aequilibrium, grounded Chinese coastal city. Reference image is PALETTE AND BRUSHWORK ONLY. Keep matte dry gouache/oil brush edges, realistic architectural proportions, desaturated slate blue/gray, muted moss, tobacco wood, soft natural light and small restrained warm accents, fine pigment texture. No people, no readable words, no text/UI/logos, no neon, no anime, no glossy CGI. This location must be recognizably independent with its OWN architecture, layout and furnishing. Do not copy the reference bookshop's shelves, leaking roof, enamel basin, lamp, counter or composition. Wide eye-level shot, calm complete space, open floor for later composited characters.

briefs.district-street: A distinct daytime public old-street junction between a neighborhood bank and a securities office, NOT the rainy bookshop alley from the title screen. Overcast coastal late-morning daylight, dry pale stone paving with a few subtle damp patches. A small pale-gray stucco BANK facade on the RIGHT, with simple square columns, dark green double doors clearly visible around x75%, y48%; on the LEFT a lower red-brown tiled-roof SECURITIES office with wide frosted-glass windows and an open dark timber entrance around x20%, y50%; center-left a side lane leading back toward the bookshop around x43%, y42%. Unlettered vertical signboards and a parked bicycle, wires, distant modest port cranes. Three destinations legible through different building shapes; wide open crossing foreground. No library shelves, no interior room, no futuristic skyline, no rain streak overlay.
briefs.neighborhood-bank: Interior of a modest neighborhood BANK, recognizably a bank rather than a reading room. Pale stone floor, high cream plaster walls, worn dark-green paneled teller counter across back-left, two service windows separated by frosted glass and narrow brass grilles; visible handover trays and blank paper forms. A wall clock without clear numbers, a small closed steel archive door in back-right, three connected waiting seats against right wall. Diffused daylight through high clerestory windows on LEFT, quiet cool institutional lighting, tiny warm brass accents. Loan paperwork counter near x30%, y56%, repayment handover tray near x52%, y56%. Open center-right foreground for a fixed female bank clerk sprite. NO bookcases, NO desk lamp, NO pots catching rain, NO replication of bookshop architecture, NO huge electronic trading boards.
briefs.securities-office: Interior of a small old-city SECURITIES CLIENT OFFICE, visually distinct from both bank and bookshop. Two low walnut client desks in the left half, one open paper report with simple faint printed blocks (not readable text) on the nearer desktop around x27%, y67%, a slim corded telephone, pencils. Back wall has waist-high steel filing cabinets and a large slate-green notice panel with unlettered notices; an open passage to a back office at far left. A wide horizontal frosted window spans the upper RIGHT, showing the pale outline of the street. Two upholstered faded moss waiting chairs in the right back corner. Soft overcast afternoon daylight from right, paper and wood focus. Open center foreground. NO floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, NO bookshop counter or shop lamp, NO enamel basin, NO rain-leaking ceiling, NO teller grilles, NO giant screens, no financial dashboards.
